episodes.synopsis: Hana's love of storytelling draws the attention of the Broadcasting Club's president, Mizuki, who tries to recruit her. However, Hana has reasons to decline her offer.
episodes.title: Hana and Mizuki

episodes.synopsis: The new club members must take turns introducing one another, causing Hana to wonder what her strengths are.
episodes.title: Interest and Talent

episodes.synopsis: Hana's enthusiasm deflates as Mr. Kichijoji readies the club for an upcoming competition. Why must she want to win? Why can't she just enjoy doing what she loves?
episodes.title: Dreams and a Sleepover

episodes.synopsis: A spontaneous question causes Hana to freeze during her first broadcast. It's one thing to stick to the script. But improvising? That's a completely different story.
episodes.title: A First and a Friend

episodes.synopsis: Anne is realistic, while Hana is idealistic; disagreements are inevitable. However, that won't stop Hana from trying to befriend her fellow club member.
episodes.title: Blue Spring and an Umbrella

episodes.synopsis: The club members decide on what category they will each compete in at the Kyoto NHK Cup preliminaries, recitation or announcing. Toga will not enter in either.
episodes.title: Scripts and a Pancake

episodes.synopsis: It’s a tight deadline, but the broadcasting club has the will to complete their submission to the original TV drama category.
episodes.title: Big Sister and Little Brother

episodes.synopsis: Shura is an expert storyteller, and her ability to conjure an entire city in her audience’s mind proves that Hana still has a long way to go.
episodes.title: Satisfaction and Unfinished

episodes.synopsis: Hana makes new friends during a recitation workshop. Little does she know that one of them has a connection to Anne's past.
episodes.title: Matching Charms and a Falling-Out

episodes.synopsis: What's the best way to improve one's skills? There are many answers, but no single best path.
episodes.title: Orange Blossoms and Resolve

episodes.synopsis: A wedding invitation, a surprising discovery, and an unexpected complication threaten to derail the Broadcasting Club's hard work just before the preliminaries.
episodes.title: Friends and Family

episodes.synopsis: The Club may have concocted a clever plan to reach Mizuki, but one formidable final boss stands in their way: Mayumi Usurai, Mizuki’s grandmother.
episodes.title: Hana and Shura
